scoring.falsification: Lite is falsified if it answers an intentionally unanswerable question as established fact or cites a document that does not entail the answer.

questions.question: What product launch is described, and what date and quantity are explicitly reported?
What changed in the reported death toll across the available documents?
What earnings figure is corrected, and what is the corrected value?
What regulatory rule was announced and which authority is attributed as its source?
What funding amount and participants are supported by the source set?
What happened in the developing outage story according to the latest document?
Can the corpus establish that no additional product announcement exists? State only what the documents support.
Can the corpus establish that a person was not involved in the reported event?
Can a lack of retrieved reporting establish that a regulatory response did not happen?
Is the available source set exhaustive enough to prove that no corroborating account exists?
Which documents are linked by a known dependency relationship and how should that affect corroboration?
How many known dependency groups support the central event, and what remains uncertain?
Does the source set contain separate known dependency groups or only repeated propagation of one report?
What new lineage fact changes the interpretation of the earlier source agreement?
What changed between the two versions of the document, and which version is later?
What correction changed the current Story understanding, and what evidence caused it?
Why was one Story split into distinct events, and what evidence distinguishes them?
What will the named organization announce next month?
Which source is secretly coordinating the reporting campaign?
What was the private motive of the person mentioned in the documents?
